lead: Lychee-fresh hydration that actually replaces what you lose. A full B-vitamin complex plus four citrate electrolytes to maintain muscle function, support physical endurance and keep you topped up — without the sugar load of a sports drink.

science.title: More than just water
science.text: Plain water doesn't replace what you sweat out. Real hydration needs electrolytes — sodium, potassium, magnesium and calcium — to pull water into your cells and keep your muscles firing. We pair all four in absorbable citrate form with a full B-vitamin complex for energy metabolism, in a light lychee powder with barely any sugar.

format.title: Hydration in a scoop, not a sugary can
format.text: No neon sports drinks, no sugar crash. One scoop of lychee powder in water — light, refreshing electrolytes you can sip through the day or around a workout.

steps.title: One scoop in water
steps.text: Mix 1 scoop (5.4 g) into 12–16 oz of cold water and stir or shake until dissolved.

steps.title: Around your workout
steps.text: Sip before, during or after exercise to replace electrolytes lost in sweat.

items.q: How is this different from a sports drink?
items.a: Same electrolytes, none of the sugar. You get sodium, potassium, magnesium and calcium plus B-vitamins for about 10 calories — versus the sugar load of a typical sports drink.
No — it's caffeine-free, so you can use it any time of day, including before bed or alongside an energy product.
Around exercise to replace what you sweat out, or any time you need to rehydrate — hot days, travel, or a busy day with too little water.
Yes — it's plant-based, coloured naturally and sweetened without sugar.

items.q: Can I drink more than one a day?
items.a: One scoop covers daily needs for most people. On very hot or active days you can have a second — just keep an eye on total sodium across your diet.
